g.title: KayaRank5Convo3 begins.
g.text: KayaRank5Convo3 begins.

g.title: j1940267074
g.text: Ohhh hi, may I kindly introduce you to a 101 on JINYMON CARDS?

g.title: j2709756368
g.text: Amir of course is thrilled he finally has someone to play with (and lose to).

g.title: j2165803221
g.text: But we both thought it would be fun to get you into Jinymon.

g.title: j976461874
g.text: You guys play. I'm busy [End.]

g.title: j370884578
g.text: I've got some höllars burning a hole in my pocket, where do we start?

g.title: j534320838
g.text: Remind me... what are we talking about?

g.title: j145506587
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j2012175686
g.text: Ooookay yeah! Right so like, first. Let's focus on you. Do you see yourself as more like a Dragon, an Eagle, or a Panther?

g.title: j510537667
g.text: It's only THE most popular show, game, collectible in 1999!

g.title: Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank5Convo4.
g.text: Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank5Convo4.

g.title: j145506587->Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank5Convo4.
j3305437872
g.text: A Panther.

g.title: j3799778689
g.text: An Eagle.

g.title: j2692448582
g.text: A Dragon.

g.title: j3015215788
g.text: You know like super cool characters and creatures...

g.title: j757637360
g.text: K then you would ABSOLUTELY want to start the game with Tailala

g.title: j2798553944
g.text: K so you would DEFINITELY want to start the game with Plumebert

g.title: j85338036
g.text: K so you would PROBABLY want to start the game with Frogobogo.

g.title: j858748661
g.text: Not the point I guess. Anyway, let's start with you. Do you see yourself as more like a Dragon, an Eagle, or a Panther?

g.title: j3780104951
g.text: Which is like the coolest option but def tricky, starts really weak.

g.title: j3138128812
g.text: Which is a bit advanced but really cool.

g.title: j1639824571
g.text: Which is a great choice for beginners.

g.title: j547986591
g.text: But by the end? The most gorgeous and majestic Panther is yours basically.

g.title: j1163328403
g.text: And Plumebert is super cute because you can feed him Fizzy Grapes to level up faster than everyone else.

g.title: j2633920054
g.text: And sure you start with basically the cutest frog ever but eventually if you win enough battles..

g.title: j457218242
g.text: Totally a classy choice.

g.title: j2980310458
g.text: Which lets you unlock a whole Crop system.

g.title: j46333504
g.text: You can level Frogobogo into a DRAGON.

g.title: j2918519576
g.text: What exactly is this game...

g.title: j2148754712
g.text: Right okay so you collect Jinymons and they battle for you and you get to adventure around.

g.title: j3412450309
g.text: But that's in the video game version. In the card game version it's like you ARE doing the battles only against someone else in real life.

g.title: j3634997599
g.text: It's like all the same idea though. Jinymon Jinymon Jinymon.

g.title: j2231707739
g.text: So, ready to play your first match?

g.title: j2058403262
g.text: No way. [End.]

g.title: j2172180779
g.text: Sure why not, beginners luck has to be on my side.

g.title: j4116110730
g.text: You just want an easy win. No way.

g.title: j1075788178
g.text: No, I am more confused now. You didn't explain anything!

g.title: j990574052
g.text: Great... you just need to fork over like 10,000 höllars for a starter pack of your own...

g.title: j3946933001
g.text: Oh come on... I'll go easy on you. I'll even let Amir help you!

g.title: j2662110523
g.text: If you say so...

g.title: j2974978511
g.text: What the! I don't have that kind of money.

g.title: j4250372176
g.text: And if you win I'll give you an unopened Jinymon pack!

g.title: j457244826
g.text: It's no problem, if you could just put your banking info right here....

g.title: j1096930712
g.text: Alright, fine. Only if Amir can help me.

g.title: j814250037
g.text: How about a raincheck?

g.title: j3023965653
g.text: No way!

g.title: j568765491
g.text: I'm not falling for that!

g.title: j1523369657
g.text: Alright, 4..1

g.title: j3836936077
g.text: Fineeee.

g.title: j2072154431
g.text: Congratulations, you passed the K.O.L safety test.

g.title: j3446937573
g.text: OMG NO! It was a test, you are NOT supposed to put your banking information on the K.O.L internet services!

g.title: j1350544516
g.text: Omg Amir was soo sure you'd fall for it.

g.title: j2814305866
g.text: Ugh Damnit! I owe Amir a game. He said you'd fall for it.

g.title: j3298282899
g.text: But yeah we'll play later.
